translations.web: They spoke the word of the Lord to him, and to all who were in his house.
translations.bsb: Then Paul and Silas spoke the word of the Lord to him and to everyone in his house.
translations.kjv: And they spake unto him the word of the Lord, and to all that were in his house.
translations.asv: And they spake the word of the Lord unto him, with all that were in his house.
